Points of Interest == === Old Amber Event === After obtaining Cut, the player can start an event in [[Pewter City#Museum|Pewter City Museum]] where they need to help a scientist collect an {{ItemIcon|OLDAMBER}} Old Amber on the eastern side of the forest. Four Beedrills will need to be fought here to reach the rock containing the {{ItemIcon|OLDAMBER}} Old Amber. After returning to the museum, the player will receive the {{ItemIcon|OLDAMBER}} Old Amber which they will need to travel to [[Cinnabar Island]] to be able to revive it. === Kurt Rematch === After defeating the [[Elite Four]], Kurt can be found at the south entrance to the forest during the [[Time|morning]]. After talking to him, he will appear at the Fighting Arena in [[Vermillion City]] for a [[Gym Leader rematches|rematch]]. [[Category:Locations]] [[Category:Kanto]]
